title: Over and understock
intro: Overstock is stock above the larger of calculated Max and the 6-month forecast. Understock is position below calculated ROP. VITAL items come first: they are availability problems before they are cost problems.

tiles.label: Excess inventory
tiles.definition: Excess = closing stock above max(calculated Max, 6-month engine forecast). The brief asks for the 12-month forecast; the engine horizon is 6 months, so the 12-month threshold is Not computable on demo scope and the 6-month forecast is used and labelled.
tiles.baseline: None: a level, 6-month forecast used (12-month not computable)
tiles.source: RAW FACT_INVENTORY_SNAPSHOT x DIM_MATERIAL; Max and demand from ContextFlow predict-batch

tiles.label: Materials under reorder level
tiles.definition: Position (closing + on order + approved PR awaiting PO) below calculated ROP.
tiles.source: RAW FACT_INVENTORY_SNAPSHOT x DIM_MATERIAL; Max and demand from ContextFlow predict-batch

tiles.label: Stock-outs
tiles.source: RAW FACT_INVENTORY_SNAPSHOT; curated INVENTORY_CLASSIFICATION shows the same 15 STOCKOUT

notes: Five materials are not computable on demo scope: no forward forecast (HZL1005107, HZL1005876, HZL1005880, HZL1005932, HZL1005933).
Two excess lines have no forward demand in the engine output and are shown as such: INR 3,141,176.80. Negative engine means were clamped to zero for HZL1003336 and HZL1004476.
Annual holding cost on the excess at 8%: INR 332,871.10. This is an assumption stated in the build, not a measurement.
Curated plant-wide EXCESS_INVENTORY_VALUE_INR is INR 240,798,934.10 on a different scope and rule; it is not comparable and is not adjusted.
